answers.note: GameCube — домашняя консоль Nintendo, впервые выпущенная в 2001 году.

literal.prompt: Как называлась за пределами Японии консоль Nintendo Family Computer, или Famicom?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: UK L161 explicitly says Famicom was later renamed Nintendo Entertainment System (NES) for worldwide launch; corporate L114-L117 directly says FamilyComputer System is known as NintendoEntertainmentSystem outsideJapan. This supports slot2 uniquely. SuperNintendoEntertainmentSystem corresponds instead toSuperFamicom atUK L186, while GameCube andNintendo64 are distinct later home systems atUK L204/L225 andcorporate L142/L153. All labels are console/system names of the same category; SNES is especially plausible because it differs by the Super generation marker. No grammatical inflection or exceptional label format gives the key.
